articles.summary: Primo Brands Corporation (NYSE: PRMB) ("Primo Brands" or the "Company") today announced its results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. "Our third quarter results demonstrate solid top-line momentum and improving execution across the business," said Eric Foss, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. "This led to Direct Delivery growth ahead of our expectations, broad-based Retail sales growth, and category dollar share gains. "We continue to make progress in a dynamic cost environment and remain focused on factors within our control to help mitigate macro-cost pressures while continuing to invest for long-term growth. Based on our year-to-date performance and proactive actions, we expect to deliver Net Sales at the midpoint of our previous guidance range and Adjusted EBITDA at the lower end of our previous guidance range for 2026. "As a leader in the growing and resilient water category, we benefit from a strong brand portfolio and differentiated route-to-market
articles.title: Primo Brands Reports 2026 Third Quarter Results
